description: Check a human review created by request_review: awaiting_review, approved (with burnJobId and, when finished, the burned video URL), rejected (note says why; nothing charged), or expired. Free, read-only; needs the key that created it. Poll it after sharing reviewUrl; once burnJobId exists you can also poll get_job for that burn.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.
